_documentation: Owner: r2mlvs14-remaining-assets-and-runtime-integration.md Group62.1; original cargo-rocket source model/brief from public/native model14, no source selection or runtime authority.

native_roles.construction: Original LaunchCenter-only paid hull; SpaceBuildKind::Rocket/model14,12Steel+16Goods/capital400000/work148ticks/dry_mass320sixteenths. Art creates none of these assets.
native_roles.payload: Original rocket_payload_sixteenths=30*16; real passenger/probe or actual refitted freight and separate propellant/service compartments stay with SpaceManifest/Vehicle CargoPackets.
native_roles.flight: Same original SpaceTransition hull: GroundLoading, Preparing, Ascent, OrbitalDelivery, ReturnRecovery, Turnaround, Holding. Real outbound/recovery burn receipts and current block own all phase selection.
native_roles.service: Rocket14 has no probe-service countdown. Published service source is actual native postflight Turnaround/handling presentation, never an invented SpaceManifest service job.
native_roles.direction: Existing native engine-viewport N/NE/E/SE/S/SW/W/NW views; author genuine model yaw views, never rotate/mirror a flat sprite.

model.form: One compact upright reusable unmanned cargo rocket, squat ogive payload capsule above one cylindrical main tank/booster; one integrated graphite base engine bell, exactly four short landing/stabilizer feet in a fixed square arrangement.
model.identity: One recessed dark-blue rectangular control/service plate on physical local+Y face, one closed charcoal payload-access seam on that same face, a single thin ochre waist band; no second booster, external payload or extra antenna.
model.style: Existing M1 chunky low-detail machinery; matte warm cream/pale gray hull, charcoal base/feet/nozzle, dark-blue control plate, restrained ochre band, upper-left SCREEN light. No text/logos/numbers.
model.ready: Whole sealed empty-looking outer hull, all four short feet deployed, no exhaust, hatch opening, people, cargo, probe/pod, platform, water, road, track, labels or backdrop.
model.physical_contact: Fixed native source reference[32,32] at center of landing-foot ground plane. Target ready body envelope[16,2,48,38], within unchanged full native art envelope[2,2,62,46]; preserve room below main nozzle for genuine later phase effects.
model.camera: Orthographic native2:1 ground basis; camera elevation30degrees and azimuth45degrees, upper-left screen light; upright body yaw creates genuine headings. NE base shows local+Y control/access face on the screen-right visible hull surface.

phase_policy: Ready/loading retain sealed hull; Preparing from actual paid preparation; Ascent and ReturnRecovery may use genuinely authored effect phases only under native flight/burn owners; Orbit is actual Space delivery/coast; Blocked follows actual original SpaceFlightBlock; Service maps actual Turnaround. Static aliases wherever native/art body is unchanged; no frame/request/wall-time clock, free fuel or painted payload quantity.
